predecessor: model/specs/representation.json version 3: main run outcome fail_pivot (e-prop captured 0.7% of the backpropagation gain); decision research/decisions/gate-a-2026-11-26.md, option (a)
rationale: Frozen 2026-11-26 before any run of this spec. A2 is now the mainline online-gradient learner: single-pass truncated backpropagation through time (windows of 32 bytes, Adam, gradient-norm clip 1.0, learning rate 0.001 chosen on the development role in the version-1/2 pilots of the predecessor spec), every update logged. The core, stream, probe, and data roles are those of the predecessor main run, except that the held-out role is two source groups of books held back whole and never seen by any earlier run (gutenberg-fresh-fiction, gutenberg-fresh-nonfiction), and the seeds are new. Thresholds, set from the predecessor's pilot and main-run measurements of this same rule (these were seen; they are why the thresholds are placed well below them and why this run is a confirmation under mainline rules, not a fresh discovery): r 0.5 against a measured probe gain of 1.1-1.4 BPB; gain_over_byte_frequency 1.0 against a measured gap of about 1.6 (byte frequency about 4.5 BPB against about 2.9); kappa_min 0.5 against a measured retention of about 1.0; max_regression 0.25 BPB between milestones against a measured worst regression of 0.08; max_abs_weight 100; max_shared_window_fraction 0.01 (a judgement, as in the predecessor). Thresholds are never changed after the main run starts. A rerun after INCONCLUSIVE uses new seeds and a new held-out role.
